newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN FALLING ON SELECTIVE TRADING.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN FALLING ON SELECTIVE TRADING.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected fall marginally on Wednesday amid selective trading, brokers said.
"Shares which lost heavily in recent sessions may draw buyers. Scrips which either remained stable or gained may suffer selling pressure," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.
Brokers said shares in engineering and leather sectors might fall while cement and financial scrips were likely to gain.
The DSE all-share price index dropped 8.34 percent, or 0.87 percent, to 946.55 on turnover of 54.7 million taka on Tuesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-869749
